description: fz-1ah.8 made dispatch_reachability the shared authority. During the fz-1ah.7 telemetry-boundary integration, the former compiler2/jobs/semantic.rs traversal remains only as unreachable compatibility code because both changes overlap that file. Remove the obsolete traversal and its test-only support after the typed telemetry migration has landed; retain only calculate_dispatch_reachability. This is cleanup, not a behavior change.
title: Remove superseded local dispatch reachability helper
